reels.caption:
Some projects give themselves away the moment you lay eyes on them.

And it's not because of a pretty render...
it's because of basic details that many people still get wrong.
• Cabinets touching the floor.
• Incorrect heights.
• Dimensions measured in the wrong place.

That's not "style."
That's a lack of technical mastery.
And the worst part:
the client doesn't know how to explain it...
but they feel like something is wrong.

Now look at the other side:
• Suspended cabinets.
• Correct heights.
• Right proportions.
Same project.
Completely different perception.

👉 This is what separates those who just draw...
from those who actually design.
If you still treat this as just a "detail,"
you're delivering projects that look amateur and you don't even realize it.

#washbasin #washbasindesign #sanyamboraarchitects #architecture #interior
